mmq.text: Cho-Manno declares that Mercadia's masks can no longer hide the truth, and he tells Orim that he did not choose his role and neither did Gerrard, before resolving to ally with Gerrard to free his people.
Orim learns that Cho-Manno took the Weatherlight's arrival as a sign of Ramos's return, and she grows sympathetic to the Cho-Arrim, and the two kiss.
Believed dead, Cho-Manno reappears and clears Orim's name through a mind meld, and disguised as guards the crew and Cho-Manno free Gerrard using a storm.

During the Revolution Cho-Manno, Orim and others attack the tower, where Orim kills the Chief Magistrate with a Kyren poison dart, and afterward Orim, Cho-Manno and Atalla become the new leaders of Mercadia.
